full_prompt_en: A square frame holds a wide, softly colored animated comedy scene of two startled men seated together on a turquoise sofa in a warm living room. Solid black bands run above and below the horizontal scene, making it read like a film still inside the square. The back wall is pale beige, with framed pictures, a central door, a distant decorative object, and a lamp reduced to gentle blurred shapes. The sofa back crosses the lower middle in a cool blue-green strip that separates the figures from the room. On the left, a blond man with swept-up hair wears a light tan jacket over a pale waistcoat, white shirt, and dark patterned tie. His arms are folded tightly over his chest. His eyes are very wide, his brows arched, and a small brown mustache sits above a slightly open mouth. The narrow face and pointed chin make his frozen surprise especially clear. On the right, a brown-haired man in a darker brown suit and dark tie mirrors the folded-arm pose. His heavier mustache curves around a more openly gaping mouth, and his round eyes stare upward toward the same unseen point as his companion's. The two torsos sit close together, almost filling the width of the visible scene, while their different suit colors keep the pair separate. Thin dark outlines define the hair, noses, lapels, and hands, but broad flat color areas carry the bodies. Subtle shaded bands round the cheeks and jackets without making the drawing realistic. Warm, even interior light comes from the room ahead and to the right, leaving soft shadows along the left sides of faces and under chins. The background stays defocused and quiet so the exaggerated facial expressions command attention. The overall composition is balanced and direct, using matched poses, mismatched faces, and gentle beige-brown color to turn shared alarm into a light comic beat.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形画面容纳着横向展开、色彩柔和的喜剧动画场景：两名神情惊讶的男子并坐在温暖客厅的蓝绿色沙发上。横向场景的上方和下方各有一道纯黑色带，使它像嵌在方框内的电影画格。后墙呈浅米色，挂画、中央房门、远处装饰物与台灯被简化为柔和模糊的形状。沙发靠背以一道冷蓝绿色横穿画面下部中央，把人物和房间分开。左边的金发男子头发向上梳起，浅褐色外套里穿浅色马甲、白衬衫和深色花纹领带。他的双臂紧紧交叉在胸前。眼睛睁得很圆，眉毛高挑，小小的棕色胡须位于微张的嘴上方。狭长脸形和尖下巴让凝固的惊讶更加明显。右边棕发男子穿更深的棕色西装和深色领带，以同样交叉双臂的姿势回应。更浓的胡须环绕张得更大的嘴，圆睁的眼睛与同伴一起望向画外的同一处。两人的上身紧靠，几乎占满可见场景的宽度，而不同的西装颜色使彼此仍可区分。细细的深色轮廓线划出头发、鼻子、翻领和手，身体则主要由大块平涂色彩承载。微妙的阴影色带让脸颊和外套显得圆润，却没有使画面变得写实。温暖均匀的室内光来自人物前方偏右，在脸部左侧和下巴下方留下柔软阴影。背景保持失焦和安静，使夸张的面部表情成为焦点。整体构图均衡直接，利用相似姿势、不同面容和温和的米棕色调，把两人共同的惊吓变成轻巧的喜剧瞬间。
style_prompt_en: The animated image uses rounded hand-drawn contours, clean filled color, and gently shaded planes. Features are exaggerated through large pale eyes, high curved lines, and strongly simplified mouth shapes, while the surrounding forms remain relatively restrained. Warm beige, honey brown, muted ochre, and cool turquoise are organized into broad readable blocks. Dark outlines are thin but decisive around key expressions and overlaps; secondary edges soften into a hazy, low-detail backdrop. Even interior light gives the main forms mild volume through narrow tonal bands rather than heavy shadows. A wide central stage concentrates attention on closely placed figures, with negative space and blurred props kept behind them. Repeated poses can establish a visual rhythm, while small variations in shape and color prevent mechanical symmetry. The overall effect is approachable, theatrical, and comic, with emotional clarity coming from silhouette and expression rather than dense surface detail.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅动画图像使用圆润的手绘轮廓、干净的填充色和轻柔分层的阴影。特征通过较大的浅色眼睛、高扬的曲线与强烈简化的嘴形被夸张，周围形体则相对克制。暖米色、蜂蜜棕、低饱和赭黄与冷蓝绿色被组织为宽阔易读的色块。深色轮廓线在关键表情和遮挡处细而果断，次要边缘则软化进朦胧、低细节的背景。均匀室内光借狭窄的明度色带为主形提供轻微体积，而不用沉重阴影。横向展开的中央舞台把注意力集中到彼此靠近的形体，留白和模糊道具退居其后。重复姿态建立视觉节奏，形状与颜色的小变化则防止机械对称。整体效果亲切、具有舞台感且诙谐，情绪的清晰度来自剪影与表情，而非密集的表面细节。
theme_en: Two startled cartoon men seated together on a sofa in a warm living room
theme_zh: 温暖客厅的沙发上，两名卡通男子并坐，神情惊讶
name: Comedy movie
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
